heroLead: From Mendoza, Argentina. I develop web applications that combine thoughtful design with intuitive navigation, and I turn manual processes into tools that make everyday work simpler.
aboutP1: I'm María José, though everyone calls me Majo. I study Systems Engineering at UTN and work in software development, with a particular interest in building tools that solve concrete problems.
aboutP2: I started with frontend, working with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and today I develop across the whole stack, from the interface to the database and the deploy. I'm especially interested in understanding how the people who will use an application work, and finding ways to make their tasks simpler and more efficient.
contactLead: Have an opportunity or a project in mind? Get in touch!
